title: 只缓存抽取结果的显式灾备
summary: Adds a failure-only ModelProvider decorator under covenia_b.cache. It calls the configured model on every normal request and reads a cache only after ModelUnavailable.
Derives an opaque SHA-256 key from normalised safe text, content-addressed image facts, scope/source facts, and model/prompt/schema/policy versions.
Stores only CandidateExtraction values that pass schema, source, metadata, and detectable-PII checks; it never caches an analysis response, decision, responsibility snapshot, or live state.
On a valid fallback, preserves the original extraction run_id, marks cached_result=true, and writes a redacted current-request/origin-run relation before returning the candidate.
LIVE mode forcibly bypasses cache reads and writes. Input/version changes, unsafe input, store failure, cache mutation, or cold cache cause an explicit non-hit failure.

coverage: safe text, image hash, source, scope, and version invalidation
cache corruption, cold cache, unsafe input, store failure, and audit failure
schema/source/PII/metadata cache admission and LIVE cache bypass

handoff: A later authorized wiring change may inject CachingExtractionProvider as BATCH-19's ModelProvider. It must bind the same request_id passed to AnalyzeService plus a NORMAL/CHALLENGE scope around each call.

Do not treat cached_result=true as a cached final response: AnalyzeService still validates the candidate and recomputes commitments, evidence, time, human progress, event state, metrics, and persistence on each request.
Keep LIVE provider mode at cache_enabled=false. Re-enable test-mode fallback only with a working CacheGovernanceSink and an ExtractionStore limited to CandidateExtraction.
